thread:
jules-sre: Quick postmortem follow-up. We tracked three recurring latency bursts tied to large embedding batches. Need owners, concrete acceptance criteria, and dates so we can rebaseline SLOs and update dashboards.
anika-product: I can own customer-facing SLA language and the comms plan. I'll draft a short FAQ for impacted customers.
dev-oncall: I'll take the runbook + failover tests. Short-term mitigation: add a manual throttle and an automated fallback to the quantized variant when p99 > 1s for 3 minutes.
sam-platform: I'll own dashboard panels and alert rules. Want to add per-tenant QPS, p95/p99 per model_variant, and an error-budget burn rate widget.
otto-telemetry: I'll add incident markers and a nightly regression that replays top-ten embedding prompts. Also propose a recurring query that flags tenant burst patterns.
jules-sre: Owners: SLA=anika, runbook=dev-oncall, dashboard=sam-platform, telemetry=otto. Two timelines: SLO proposal to leadership in 5 business days; full remediation sprint (all acceptance criteria green) in 14 days. Agree?
anika-product: 5 days works. Proposed SLO wording: keep shared-hosted p95 <= 320ms, add Dedicated p95 <= 275ms, and introduce a throughput SLO for embedding endpoints defined as sustained per-tenant QPS < T (T to be decided). I'll post a PR to the SLA repo.
dev-oncall: Runbook plan: new alert rule + documented manual throttle workflow + automated fallback config. Acceptance: runbook merged, failover tested in staging, pager validated. Target: prototype in 5 days.
sam-platform: Dashboard query sketch:
```
select
  tenant_id, model_variant,
  quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) as p95,
  quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) as p99,
  count() as qps
from requests
where env='prod' and request_type='embedding'
group by tenant_id, model_variant
```
I'll add a burn-rate alert when burn_rate > 1.8 for 30m and a heatmap for recurring spikes. Acceptance: panels live in grafana, alert tests pass in staging, link added to oncall home dashboard.
otto-telemetry: Adding incident markers now. I'll also wire a weekly regression job into the eval runner and attach diffs to the ticket.
infra-bot: ticket #RWD-4720 created: "Embedding-burst follow-ups - SLOs, dashboards, runbook" assigned to jules-sre, due 2026-04-25. Link: https://tickets.example/RWD-4720
jules-sre: I'll split the ticket into sub-tasks and add acceptance criteria: SLA PR merged with product signoff, runbook merged + staging test pass, grafana panels live + alert firing test, telemetry job running nightly.
anika-product: Adding comms checklist: customer RFC snippet, internal FAQ, support playbook.
dev-oncall: For immediate relief I'll add a feature-flagged proxy throttle that infra can flip during observed burn spikes. Documented in runbook.
sam-platform: Timeline recap: SLO proposal in 5 business days, runbook prototype in 5 days, dashboards merged in 7 days, full remediation sweep complete in 14 days.
otto-telemetry: I'll attach a short-run history and perf diffs to the ticket for leadership review.
jules-sre: One more note: this is the 4th similar incident in 6 months. Long-term backlog item: per-tenant rate-limiter or Dedicated fast-path provisioning. Adding to backlog and tagging product/solutions.
anika-product: Agreed. We'll include Dedicated offering in the next QBR discussion.
dev-oncall: Scheduling a failover test window in staging tomorrow; will post results in the ticket.
sam-platform: I'll open a PR for dashboard changes and request review from oncall.
jules-sre: I'll update the postmortem with owners, ticket links, and schedule a 20-min sync in 48h to check progress. Ping here for blockers. :thumbsup:
